arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Render ONE separate green clock-arm component in the clean black-outlined Cartoon style of image2. Image1 determines the exact pose/silhouette, attachment-end location, finger direction, hand orientation and curve. Image2 is MATERIAL/INK style only; DO NOT include its watch body or face. Tall slender J-shaped arm. Attachment endpoint at BOTTOM-left, arm runs RIGHT along its low bend and rises nearly vertically on the RIGHT to the hand in the upper-right. Index finger points UP with a slight rightward lean, folded thumb to the right. Keep the short horizontal base and open space left of the upright. Follow the source's relative hand/arm size; keep the arm slender, smooth and flexible, not a bulky tube. One green hand, one index finger extended, other fingers folded as original. Flat saturated green with modest cel highlights/shading. No new wrist cuff, no extra arm, no watch. Smooth edges, never trace pixel stair-steps. Genuine transparent background and empty interior, no external shadow, gray haze, glow, ground, scene or text. Complete asset centered with at least5% transparent margins.
